title: How deliveries go at each store
lede: Every store and mode, over the last 90 whole local days. Read only: a record only ever costs or earns a credit, and never rules a store out.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the store record
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor's run grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

failed: The store record could not be read.
costPerMeasure: Each measure costs its failure price times the steadied rate less the like-store rate. Below like stores it earns a credit.

notBuilt.title: The store record has not been built yet
notBuilt.hint: The nightly pass has not run. Every pair runs on the neutral default and costs nothing.

tillNote: Till moves marked "Customer": this store's share first, like stores' beside it. The reason is the store's own word.
fallbackNote: Deliveries that reached the store as the callout's fallback are left out of its record and counted apart.

shown.title: Shown, not charged
shown.lead: Worked out and shown. Switched off in the baseline set, so none of it costs.
shown.donorRefusals: A donor's refusals for no stock

noStores: No store has this mode in the record.
noRecordMode: These modes keep no record. Each pair runs on the neutral default and costs nothing.
